description: Compose a video ad from the catalog: pick a preset + setting (+ optional hook), attach a registered product and/or avatar, and the server fills the prompt and routes to the right video model. ASYNC — returns a job id and predicted_usd immediately; poll with check_job { kind: "studio", id } until status is "completed" (url) or "failed". Use studio_catalog to discover ids. Billed to your credit balance.

hook.description: Hook id from studio_catalog, e.g. product-hit; omit or "none" for no hook

extra_prompt.description: Extra creative direction appended to the composed prompt

model.description: Override the preset video model slug

preset.description: Preset id from studio_catalog, e.g. ugc, asmr, unboxing

setting.description: Setting id from studio_catalog, e.g. kitchen, gym, marble-counter

name: studio_generate
title: Generate a product video ad
